user.title: Brottsplatskartan
user.description: Choose the county to fetch incidents for. The next step lets you narrow it down to a municipality or a district.

data_description.area: The API only accepts whole counties. Filtering to a municipality happens in the next step.

settings.title: Narrow it down
settings.description:
Municipalities reporting incidents in {area} right now: {found}.

Leave the places field empty to count the whole county. You can also type a district by hand, for example Kungsholmen or Södermalm — anything the API names as part of a location will match.

data_description.municipalities: Leave empty for the whole county. Matching ignores case and the kommun/stad suffixes. Comparison is exact, so a street called Stockholmsvägen in Nacka does not count as Stockholm.
data_description.hours: A rolling window, so the count does not reset at midnight.
data_description.update_interval: The API rate-limits per installation; five minutes is the lowest allowed.
data_description.nearby_radius: How close an incident has to be for the 'Incident nearby' sensor to turn on.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: You should not need to change these.

data_description.max_attribute_incidents: How many incidents to put in the sensor's attributes for dashboard cards. 0 omits the list.
data_description.max_markers: A wide window over a whole county can return hundreds of incidents. The newest are kept. 0 means no cap.
data_description.max_pages: Safety stop for pagination. Raise it if a long time window looks truncated.
data_description.location_keys: Which API fields are treated as place names. Only change this if the API renames them and the municipality filter stops matching.
data_description.app_id: Identifies this installation to the API for rate limiting. Change it only if you are being rate limited.

reconfigure.title: Change county
reconfigure.description: Pick a different county for this entry. You will be able to adjust the places and everything else on the next screen.

overlapping_entries.title: Two entries cover the same incidents
overlapping_entries.description:
**{entry}** covers some of the same incidents as **{others}**.

Each entry adds its own map marker per incident, so incidents covered by both appear more than once on the map, and they are counted separately.

This is a valid setup if you meant it. If not, delete the entry you do not want under Settings → Devices & services → Brottsplatskartan (local).

duplicate_entries.title: Duplicate entries
duplicate_entries.description: **{entry}** covers exactly the same county and places as **{other}**. One of them is redundant — delete it under Settings → Devices & services → Brottsplatskartan (local).

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetches from brottsplatskartan.se straight away instead of waiting for the next update.

get_incidents.name: Get incidents
get_incidents.description: Returns the current incidents as response data, for use in a script or template. Not limited by the 'Incidents listed in attributes' option.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Return at most this many incidents, newest first.

incident_type.name: Crime type
incident_type.description: Only incidents of these types, for example Stöld or Rån. Case is ignored.

within_km.name: Within
within_km.description: Only incidents this close to home, in kilometres.
